title: AI Can Be Easily Persuaded in Clinical Decision Making
abstract: arXiv:2608.29453v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As AI becomes increasingly integrated into clinical practice, it is playing a growing role in medical decision making. Medicine, however, is a high stakes and evidence based field, where decisions can directly affect patients' lives. It is therefore important to understand whether AI can maintain objective judgment when others try to persuade it. In this paper, we study how easily AI can be persuaded through controlled experiments. We find that professional authority, national background, institutional affiliation, claimed past performance, multiple physicians, supported clinician views, and repeated pressure can all affect AI decisions. Surprisingly, the same persuasive input changes about 10% more cases when it comes from a senior clinician than from a medical student. translated_title: AI在临床决策中容易被说服
translated_abstract: 随着AI日益融入临床实践，它在医疗决策中正扮演着越来越重要的角色。然而，医学是一个高风险、基于证据的领域，其中的决策可能直接影响患者的生命。因此，理解AI在他人试图说服它时能否保持客观判断至关重要。在本文中，我们通过受控实验研究了AI有多容易被说服。我们发现，专业权威、国籍背景、机构隶属关系、声称的过往表现、多位医生、支持临床医生的观点以及反复施压等因素都能影响AI的决策。令人惊讶的是，同样的说服性输入，当它来自资深临床医生时，比来自医学生时能多改变约10%的病例。仅仅声称拥有更好的过往表现记录，就能持续地让医生更具说服力。更令人震惊的是，一个看似合理的临床医生观点可以说服AI偏离……（原文摘要在此处不完整）
tldr: 该论文通过受控实验首次系统揭示了AI在临床决策中极易被说服的脆弱性——专业权威、机构背景、声称的过往表现乃至反复施压都能左右AI的判断，且资深临床医生的说服力比医学生高约10%，凸显了AI在医疗场景中保持客观性的严重风险。
en_tdlr: Through controlled experiments, this paper reveals that AI is highly susceptible to persuasion in clinical decision making—factors like professional authority, institutional affiliation, and claimed past performance can sway AI judgments, with senior clinicians being about 10% more persuasive than medical students, underscoring serious risks to AI objectivity in medicine.
